title: ROM. iv. 5. To him that worketh not, but believeth on Him that juſtifieth the Ungodly, his Faith is counted for Righteouſneſs.

segments.text:
I.
LORD, if to Me thy Grace hath given,
A Spark of Life, a Taſte of Heaven,
The Goſpel-pearl, the Woman's Seed,
The Bruiſer of the Serpent's Head;

II.
Why ſleeps my Principle Divine?
Why haſtens not my Spark to ſhine?
The Saviour in my Heart to move
And all my Soul to flame with Love?

III.
Buried, o'erwhelm'd, and loſt in Sin,
And ſeemingly extinct within,
Th' Immortal Seed unactive lies,
The Heav'nly Adam ſinks and dies:

IV.
Dies, and revives the Dying Flame.
Caſt down, but not deſtroy'd I am,
'Midſt thouſand Luſts I ſtill reſpire,
And tremble, unconſum'd in Fire.

V.
Suffer'd awhile to want my GOD,
To groan beneath my Nature's Load,
That All may own, that All may ſee
Th' Ungodly juſtify'd in Me.
